claim: Amazon does not validate ownership of ASNs, so it limits the Amazon-side ASN to private ASNs, to protect customers from BGP spoofing; the exception is the legacy public ASN of the Region.

evidence.quote: Amazon is not validating ownership of the ASNs, therefore, we’re limiting the Amazon-side ASN to private ASNs. We want to protect customers from BGP spoofing.
We will ask you to re-enter a private ASN once you attempt to create the virtual gateway, unless it is the "legacy public ASN" of the region.
